OPERATING MODEL (Luneth-confirmed): (1) narrative/overview chapters (aging theory Ch1-3, nutrition primer Ch4, much of Ch6-9) = purify fully + mine SEARCH candidates only; mine tier-1 there only to enrich/add what the other 5 books lack, with a per-claim dedup check FIRST — verified choline->Huntington's, inositol->diabetic neuropathy, B6->epilepsy, and pellagra/scurvy/beriberi are all already mapped.
